assessments.reasoning: The instrument explicitly excludes unpaid domestic and care work when defining work/economic activity in question f.1 ('Sin considerar los quehaceres del hogar, ¿trabajó...'). Furthermore, performing domestic chores is categorized as an activity status outside of work in question f.82 ('... quien realiza los quehaceres del hogar?'). Therefore, unpaid domestic and care work is not included in the activity category.
